render_back.render_back_text: The RBICS Eligible Subindustry Table is Appendix 8 of the RBICS classification system. It includes the following RBICS subindustries, each classified at RBICS Classification Level 6 and identified by its corresponding RBICS number code and subindustry name: Nuclear Waste Handling and Disposal; Other Waste Services; Environmental Services; Environmental Consulting; Carbon Capture Services and Technologies; Waste to Energy Services; Environmental Restoration Services; Alternative Energy Boats Makers; Alt Energy Recreation Vehicle Manufacturing; Multi Type Home Furnishings Makers; Alternative Energy Car Manufacturers; Alternative Energy Motorcycles Makers; Alt Energy Motor Homes and Campers RVs Makers; Uranium Mining; Integrated Oil and Gas Exploration and Production; Electric Vehicle Batteries Manufacturing; Energy Efficient Lighting and LED Manufacturing; Fuel Cell Equipment and Technology Providers; Mixed Renewable Energy Generation Manufacturing; Photovoltaic and Solar Cells and Systems Providers; Smart Grid Technology and Smart Meter Products; Wind Energy Equipment Manufacturing; Hydroelectric Power Generation Equipment Providers; Geothermal Energy Equipment Manufacturing; Mixed Environmental Control Machine Manufacturing; Photovoltaic Production Equipment Manufacturing; Thermal and Chemical Processing Machinery Makers; Alternative Energy Transit Vehicles Makers; Alt Energy Autonomous Transit Vehicle Production; Alternative Energy Heavy Duty Trucks Makers; Alt Energy Autonomous Heavy Duty Truck Makers; Alternative Energy Infrastructure Construction; Commercial Alternative Energy Contractors; Residential Alternative Energy Contractors; Gasification Alternative Fuel Manufacturing; Other Alternative Fuel Manufacturers; Uranium Fuel Manufacturing; Hydrogen Fuel Manufacturing; Diversified Industrial Gas Manufacturing; Hydrogen Gas Manufacturing; Minimills Manufacturing Flats; Minimills Mixed Product Manufacturing.
